summary: Allocates and initializes a 20-byte structure via wrapper allocator and initializer, stores the pointer through the out-parameter, then performs a further setup call. On any failure of that call, rolls back by destroying and freeing the allocated object, nulling the out-parameter, and returning -1.

operations.description: If out_object_ptr is null, return -1 immediately.
Allocate 20 bytes through the malloc wrapper.
Initialize the freshly allocated structure with default scale; otherwise result stays null.
Store the created object pointer into the out-parameter.
Perform the object setup with the remaining arguments, capturing the result.
On non-zero setup result, roll back the created object.
Invoke the empty stub cleanup on the created object if it exists.
Free the object through the free wrapper.
Return -1 on setup failure, otherwise propagate the setup result.

unresolved: The exact role of the a2/a3/a4 arguments in the setup call at 0x00551A50 is not evident from this function alone.
